init_RemoteModelInterface: create a RemoteModelInterface instance with a serve ID, connection type, and observation keys for querying a remote robotics model
query_model: query a remote robotics model with proprioceptive and image observations to get an action chunk as a numpy array
review_RemoteModelInterface: review the RemoteModelInterface class to understand how it serializes observations and parses JSON responses from the remote model
refactor_query_model: refactor the query_model method to support additional response formats beyond JSON action chunks
test_RemoteModelInterface: test the RemoteModelInterface initialization with different RoboticsApiConnectionType values including LOCAL and CLOUD_GENAI
